scope: Retrospective additive bias calibration of saved original-photograph MiVOLO scores; no image/model reads or qualification changes
observations: Historical original age scores and summaries have already been viewed; this is not blind or independent evaluation.
Filename ages are unverified research labels. SAM conditions and estimated source ages are not ground truth.
Calibration lacks ages 60-70, development lacks age 70, and training-identity overlap and allowed uses remain unresolved.

selection.objective: Minimize subject-macro squared error over one constant additive offset; no model alternatives or calibration-group selection
selection.prediction: corrected = saved_prediction + offset; never round or clamp
selection.failures: Null predictions remain null; no effective development subject is an error

evaluation.metrics: Raw/corrected subject-macro MAE, signed bias, and sqrt(mean(subject mean squared error)); paired reductions are raw minus corrected MAE/RMSE
evaluation.population: Exactly original-role development/calibration rows bound one-to-one to N0; exclude generated and source-only records; no held-out predictions
evaluation.denominators: Retain requested/scored/failed and eligible/effective subjects for each group and stratum; empty means remain null
evaluation.missing_mae_lower: Average across eligible subjects of sum(known absolute errors)/all requested observations for that subject; all-failed subject contributes zero only to this lower bound
evaluation.missing_mae_upper: Null when any prediction is missing because no valid prediction range bounds the missing error; with complete data upper equals lower; with zero requests both are null
evaluation.domain: Original-photo corrections do not establish generated-image, sparse-render or production age calibration

uncertainty.draws: Effective subject IDs sorted lexicographically; each replicate draws n indices using random.Random(stratum_seed).randrange(n), with replacement, shared across all raw/corrected/paired metrics
uncertainty.interval: Sorted linear interpolation at (replicates-1)*q for q=0.025 and 0.975; zero effective subjects yield null intervals; one subject yields a degenerate interval
uncertainty.replicate_digest: SHA256 of UTF8 json.dumps(replicates, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False), no newline
uncertainty.limitations: Fixed-offset conditional intervals exclude offset-fitting uncertainty and missingness; development is in-sample, high-age gaps remain, and no multiple-comparison or population-generalization claim is made

integrity: Exact six metadata roles plus CLI/test/local standard-library helper pins; bounded declared-length reads and final checks, prior verification/report/plan/N0 links, original source and age-formula consistency, no duplicate or cross-group identity/image leakage; atomic fresh report publication
